name: Applies To Target
description: A Control Tower enabled control or enabled baseline applies to the organizational unit or account it is enabled on (control / baseline -> OU / account). Derived from targetIdentifier, an OU ARN (...:ou/o-.../ou-...) or an account ARN (...:account/o-.../<id>), normalized to the ARN's last segment, the OU's ou_id or the account's account_id, with the ARN's resource type naming the target type. A reference, not containment; it ends with its source, because UpdateEnabledControl and UpdateEnabledBaseline take no target.
